animations: Framer Motion staggered entry for collection grids
Kinetic marquee text ticker moving horizontally
Quick-add drawer modal with fluid transitions

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set data-testid on interactive buttons, links, search inputs, modal triggers, and cart elements
Header must be sticky/fixed with backdrop-blur and visible desktop nav items (not behind hamburger menu)
Hero section MUST use the verified replacement mp4 video URLs with muted autoplay loop
Do NOT use pure #000000 gradients for background. Keep the site light minimalist (#FAF9F6) with electric yellow (#FFE500) accents
Ensure high contrast on text buttons and hover states
